title: Vendor Gravity Map & Escape‑Risk Signals — automated scoring for prioritized fallback readiness
creator: Sofia Rivera
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers and platform teams lack a single prioritized signal that combines model availability risk (outage / supply shock), latency arbitrage potential, and the customer-specific cost of switching. This makes it hard to automate fallbacks, trigger procurement, or recommend Dedicated capacity for at-risk customers.

Goal: Build an automated scoring pipeline and UI layer — the Vendor Gravity Map — that ranks model variants by (1) Escape‑Risk (probability a customer will need to switch within 90 days), (2) Latency/Cost Arbitrage (expected per-request delta if a fallback is used), and (3) Operational Friction (integration/migration effort). The output will drive watchlist alerts, canary rollout rules, and a prioritized procurement queue.

Scope (MVP):
- Data inputs: recent model outage history, region capacity signals, latency percentiles by region/model, contract/commitment types, customer usage profiles (top routes + token volumes), and third‑party supply signals (OSS release cadence, vendor announcements).
- Scoring engine: weighted score with configurable weights; initial weights set by PM+Research and tunable via console.
- Outputs: per-customer per-region ranked list of vulnerability (escape-risk), watchlist feed for Sales/CS, and a prototype UI in Console (read-only) for review.
- Automation: rules to trigger a PM/Sales alert when escape-risk > threshold and cost-arbitrage > $0.003/token and customer ARR > $250k.

Out of scope for MVP: automated contract negotiation, enforcement of fallback via infra automation, and multi-model ensemble optimization.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring pipeline computes daily Vendor Gravity scores for at least 95% of models in catalog
Console prototype shows ranked vulnerability for 10 pilot customers and supports weight tuning
Watchlist feed generated and reviewed by Sales/CS with at least one prioritized procurement action logged
Documentation (Confluence) describes data sources, scoring formula, and caveats
success_metrics: Precision: >= 60% of top-10 flagged customers considered for procurement or fallback within 30 days
Reduction: target 15% decrease in unplanned fallback incidents for pilot customers over 90 days
Time to detection: average time between supply signal and alert <= 48 hours
Operational adoption: Sales/CS click-through from watchlist > 25% for pilot cohort
tasks: Finalize scoring formula and initial weights (PM+Research)
Implement daily ingestion job for outage and capacity signals (ENG)
Compute latency/cost arbitrage deltas from performance dashboards (SRE)
Prototype Console UI read-only view (Design + Frontend)
Run pilot with 10 customers and collect feedback (Sales/CS)
Document monitoring and false-positive mitigation guidance (PM)
Hand off rules to Automation team for future enforcement (ENG)
